probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1. (Currently Amended) An apparatus for profiling a beam of a light emitting semiconductor device, comprising: a light emitting semiconductor device comprising an active region formed on a substrate and configured to generate light when a suitable electrical current is applied to contacts on an upper surface of the device, and a light emitting surface defined by a lower surface of the substrate opposite the contacts; and a transmission medium comprising a first surface in contact with at least part of the light emitting surface of the semiconductor device and a diffusion surface, opposite the first surface, __wherein the diffusion surface is configured to diffuse light emitted from the semiconductor device and transmitted through the transmission medium, and wherein the transmission medium is optically coupled to the light emitting surface such that light from the light emitting surface enters the transmission medium at an interface with a refractive index difference of less than 0.5 between the transmission medium and the substrate__.

3. (Currently Amended) An apparatus according to claim 1 or 2, wherein the transmission medium has a refractive index substantially equal to a refractive index of the substrate of the light emitting semiconductor device, such that there is substantially no reflection at the interface between the transmission medium and the substrate of the light emitting semiconductor device, __and wherein the transmission medium comprises a material selected from the group consisting of glass and sapphire__.

9. (Currently Amended) An apparatus according to any preceding claim, __further comprising a pair of probes configured to apply an electrical current to the contacts of the light emitting semiconductor device for causing the active region to generate light, wherein the pair of probes are positioned to contact the contacts on the upper surface of the device__.

23. (Currently Amended) An apparatus according to any of claims 1 to 22, __comprising a plurality of light emitting semiconductor devices, wherein the first surface of the transmission medium is in contact with the light emitting surfaces of more than one of the plurality of light emitting semiconductor devices, and wherein each of the plurality of light emitting semiconductor devices is independently addressable for profiling__.

25. (Currently Amended) A method for profiling a beam of a light emitting semiconductor device, the method comprising: applying an electrical current to contacts on an upper surface of a light emitting semiconductor device, the light emitting semiconductor device comprising an active region formed on a substrate and a light emitting surface defined by a lower surface of the substrate opposite the contacts; transmitting light emitted from the light emitting semiconductor device through a transmission medium comprising a first surface in contact with at least part of the light emitting surface of the light emitting semiconductor device and a diffusion surface, opposite the first surface, __wherein the diffusion surface is configured to diffuse light emitted from the light emitting semiconductor device and transmitted through the transmission medium, and wherein the transmission medium is optically coupled to the light emitting surface__; and determining intensity power of light that would be emitted into air from the light emitting semiconductor device at one or more angles with respect to a normal, __wherein the determining step comprises imaging light at the diffusion surface and processing the image to calculate the angles based on the position of light at the diffusion surface and the optical properties of the transmission medium__.

26. (Currently Amended) A method for profiling a beam of a light emitting semiconductor device, the method comprising: processing, by a beam profiler, an image to determine intensity power of light that would be emitted into air from the light emitting semiconductor device at one or more angles with respect to a normal, the image comprising light emitted from a light emitting semiconductor device comprising an active region formed on a substrate and configured to generate light when a suitable electrical current is applied to contacts on an upper surface of the device, and a light emitting surface defined by a surface of the substrate opposite the contacts, the light further being transmitted through a transmission medium comprising a first surface in contact with at least part of the light emitting surface of the light emitting semiconductor device and a diffusion surface, opposite the first surface, __wherein the diffusion surface is configured to diffuse light emitted from the light emitting semiconductor device and transmitted through the transmission medium, and wherein the beam profiler determines the angles by calculating the refraction of light rays through the transmission medium based on the refractive indices of the transmission medium and the substrate and the thickness of the transmission medium__.

28. (Currently Amended) A non-transitory computer readable medium comprising computer readable code configured, when read by a computer, to carry out the method according to claim 26 or 27, __wherein the computer readable code is configured to process an image of light at a diffusion surface and calculate angles of light emission into air by applying Snell's law to account for refraction through the transmission medium__.

29. (Currently Amended) A computer program comprising computer readable code configured, when read by a computer, to carry out the method according to claim 26 or 27, __wherein the computer program is configured to process an image of light at a diffusion surface and calculate angles of light emission into air by applying Snell's law to account for refraction through the transmission medium__.
